nodes.label: The District Restaurant Exterior at Night
nodes.description: Nighttime exterior street-level photograph of The District restaurant storefront in Hamilton. The facade features a bold black exterior with large white graffiti-style lettering reading 'THE DISTRICT' across the front. A secondary sign reading 'TAPAS +' is visible to the right. Large floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a warmly lit interior with pendant lighting, colorful wall art, and patrons seated at tables. The building is a red-brick structure with illuminated upper-floor windows. The mood is vibrant and inviting, contrasting the dark night with warm amber interior lighting. Visual style is urban and contemporary, suited for marketing and atmosphere photography on a restaurant website.
nodes.purpose: Brand and atmosphere marketing — conveys the restaurant's identity, street presence, and inviting nighttime ambiance to website visitors
nodes.visual_style: high-contrast night photography with warm interior glow
